property.text: Gas limit must be >= GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000). check_gas_limit (SG-015) must enforce this absolute minimum.

reachability.notes: A proposer sets gas limit below 5000. If accepted, blocks cannot include even minimal transactions.

property.severity_justification: Extremely low gas limit is disruptive but requires sustained proposer control to be effective.

property.text: System transactions must always originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe). process_system_transaction (SG-008) must set origin and caller to SYSTEM_ADDRESS.

reachability.notes: If the system address is set incorrectly, system contracts receive calls from unexpected callers, potentially bypassing caller-based access controls.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect system address allows non-system callers to interact with system contracts as if privileged.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate a system transaction executing with a caller other than SYSTEM_ADDRESS.

property.text: System transaction gas must be fixed at SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30,000,000). process_system_transaction (SG-008) must use exactly this gas amount.

reachability.notes: If system transaction gas is not fixed, a lower value could cause system contracts to fail due to insufficient gas, while a higher value wastes resources.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect gas allocation could cause system contract failures (too low) or resource waste (too high).
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate system transaction executing with gas != 30,000,000.

property.text: System transactions must not transfer value. process_system_transaction (SG-008) must set should_transfer_value=False and value=0.

reachability.notes: If value transfer is enabled for system transactions, ETH could be moved from/to the SYSTEM_ADDRESS, creating or destroying supply.

property.severity_justification: Value transfer in system transactions could create or destroy ETH, affecting total supply integrity.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate a system transaction transferring non-zero value.

property.text: Receipt succeeded field must be True if and only if error is None. make_receipt (SG-007) must set succeeded = (error is None).

reachability.notes: If the succeeded field does not match the error state, clients disagree on transaction success/failure. This affects receipt_root computation.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect receipt succeeded field causes receipt_root divergence, leading to consensus failure.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate a receipt where succeeded != (error is None).

property.text: Receipt bloom must be computed from transaction logs via logs_bloom. make_receipt (SG-007) must set bloom = logs_bloom(logs).

reachability.notes: Incorrect bloom filter computation causes receipt_root and block bloom divergence.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect bloom causes receipt_root mismatch and block bloom mismatch, both consensus-critical checks.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate bloom filter mismatch causing consensus divergence.

property.text: Block hash list must return at most 256 hashes in ascending block number order. get_last_256_block_hashes (SG-002) must return hashes ordered by increasing block number, with length <= 256.

reachability.notes: Internal function for building the BLOCKHASH opcode environment. Not directly reachable by external attackers.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect block hash list affects BLOCKHASH opcode behavior but is not directly exploitable.

property.text: Only the most recent block hash is computed via keccak256; earlier hashes use parent_hash from successors. get_last_256_block_hashes (SG-002) must compute keccak256 only for the most recent block header.

reachability.notes: Performance invariant for hash computation. Incorrect implementation would produce the same result but slower.

property.severity_justification: Performance optimization concern, not a security issue.

property.text: apply_fork must be an identity transformation for Osaka. apply_fork (SG-001) must return the state unchanged (no irregular state transition at fork boundary).

reachability.notes: Fork application is internal and not reachable by external attackers. Any bug would cause state divergence at the fork block.

property.severity_justification: An incorrect fork transition would cause state divergence at the fork block but is a one-time event.

property.text: All exception classes must inherit from InvalidTransaction. Every validation error raised by transaction_validation_dispatch (SG-004 of exceptions.py) must be a subclass of InvalidTransaction.

reachability.notes: Exception hierarchy is an implementation concern. If an exception does not inherit InvalidTransaction, error handling code may miss it.

property.severity_justification: Type hierarchy bug could cause incorrect error handling but does not directly compromise security.
